mapping_policy: G00-G15 and AF00-AF11 are NOT one-to-one. Some G gates map to multiple AF gates and vice versa; some gates on both sides have no counterpart (AF != admission boundary, stated explicitly). Every record below carries why, fixtures/evidence, mandatory flag, currency, and open items. No hand-written PASS exists anywhere in this file: PASS verdicts are computed by standing_generator.py from FIXTURE_EVIDENCE_TRACE rows plus GATE_DIRECT_EVIDENCE bundles.
